# Windows Update
> Microsoft’s Windows Update service provides operating system updates, security patches, drivers, and update management guidance for Windows devices.

This site and its related Microsoft documentation cover Windows Update for consumers, IT administrators, and developers, including update deployment, policy configuration, release health, and Windows Update for Business.

## Windows Update Home
- [Windows Update](https://www.windowsupdate.com/): Entry point for Microsoft’s Windows Update service.
- [Windows Update: FAQ](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/windows-update-faq-8a5c2a5f-6b2d-4f6d-9f4a-4f4f4f4f4f4f): Answers common questions about installing and managing Windows updates.
- [Update Windows](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/update-windows-3c5ae7fc-9fb6-9af1-1984-b5e0412c556a): End-user instructions for checking for and installing updates.

## Windows Release Health
- [Windows Release Health](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/release-health/): Central hub for Windows release information, known issues, and servicing status.
- [Windows 11 Release Information](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/release-health/windows11-release-information): Version history, servicing timeline, and known issues for Windows 11.
- [Windows 10 Release Information](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/release-health/release-information): Version history, servicing timeline, and known issues for Windows 10.
- [Message Center](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/release-health/message-center): Announcements and important changes affecting Windows servicing and updates.
- [Known Issues and Notifications](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/release-health/status-windows-11-24h2): Current known issues and safeguards for supported Windows releases.

## Windows Update for Business
- [Windows Update for Business Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/waas-manage-updates-wufb): Overview of managing Windows updates directly from Microsoft services.
- [Manage Updates with Windows Update for Business](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/waas-manage-updates): Guidance for configuring update policies and deployment rings.
- [Windows Update for Business Reports](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/wufb-reports-overview): Reporting and compliance monitoring for managed Windows devices.
- [Safeguard Holds](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/safeguard-holds): Explanation of compatibility holds that block feature updates.
- [Expedite Updates](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/expedite-updates): Deploy security updates quickly to managed devices.

## Windows Update Client Policies
- [Configure Automatic Updates](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/waas-wu-settings): Policy settings for Windows Update client behavior.
- [Windows Update CSP](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/client-management/mdm/policy-csp-update): Mobile device management policy reference for update settings.
- [Group Policy Settings for Windows Update](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/waas-wu-settings#group-policy-settings-for-windows-update): Group Policy options for update configuration.
- [Delivery Optimization](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/do/delivery-optimization): Peer-to-peer content distribution settings for update downloads.
- [Active Hours](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/keep-your-device-up-to-date-with-active-hours-3f9f0b0d-0f2f-4f4d-9d3d-0d0d0d0d0d0d): Configure restart timing to reduce disruption from updates.

## Windows Server Update Services
- [WSUS Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/administration/windows-server-update-services/get-started/windows-server-update-services-wsus): Introduction to Windows Server Update Services for on-premises update management.
- [Deploy WSUS](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/administration/windows-server-update-services/deploy/2-configure-wsus): Setup and configuration guidance for WSUS infrastructure.
- [WSUS Operations Guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-server/administration/windows-server-update-services/manage/operations-guide): Day-to-day administration and maintenance for WSUS environments.
- [WSUS API Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/previous-versions/windows/desktop/bb902479(v=vs.85)): Reference for automating WSUS administration programmatically.

## Microsoft Update Catalog
- [Microsoft Update Catalog](https://www.catalog.update.microsoft.com/): Searchable catalog of downloadable Microsoft update packages.
- [Security Update Guide](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/): Search and filter Microsoft security updates and advisories.
- [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/): Security bulletins, advisories, and vulnerability response information.
- [Update History for Microsoft 365 Apps](https://learn.microsoft.com/officeupdates/update-history-microsoft365-apps-by-date): Release history for Microsoft 365 Apps updates.

## Deployment and Servicing Guides
- [Windows as a Service Overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/waas-overview): Servicing model and update cadence for modern Windows releases.
- [Plan for Windows Client Updates](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/plan-for-windows-updates): Planning guidance for update readiness and deployment strategy.
- [Manage Feature Updates](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/manage-feature-updates): Control rollout of Windows feature updates across devices.
- [Manage Quality Updates](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/manage-quality-updates): Configure and monitor monthly quality update deployments.
- [Optimize Update Delivery](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/do/waas-delivery-optimization): Improve bandwidth usage for Windows update distribution.

## Troubleshooting and Recovery
- [Windows Update Troubleshooter](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/windows-update-troubleshooter-19bc41ca-ad72-ae67-af3c-89ce169755dd): Automated troubleshooting steps for common update problems.
- [Fix Windows Update Errors](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/fix-windows-update-errors-188c2b0f-10f6-7f5c-d36f-7d3b6b3f8f4f): Troubleshooting guidance for update installation failures.
- [Windows Recovery Options](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/recovery-options-in-windows-31ce2444-7de3-818c-d626-e3b5a3024da5): Recovery tools and reset options when updates cause issues.
- [DISM Reference](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows-hardware/manufacture/desktop/what-is-dism): Deployment Image Servicing and Management tool documentation.
- [System File Checker](https://support.microsoft.com/windows/use-the-system-file-checker-tool-to-repair-missing-or-corrupted-system-files-79aa86cb-ca52-166a-92a3-966e85d4094e): Repair corrupted system files that may block updates.

## Developer and API Resources
- [Windows Update Agent API](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/wua_sdk/portal): API documentation for interacting with the Windows Update Agent.
- [Windows Update Agent Interfaces](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/wua_sdk/interfaces): COM interfaces for searching, downloading, and installing updates.
- [Windows Update Agent Tasks](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/win32/wua_sdk/using-the-windows-update-agent-api): Common programming tasks using the Windows Update Agent API.
- [Update Session Orchestration](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/update/update-session-orchestration): Concepts for update orchestration and servicing workflows.

## Support and Community
- [Microsoft Support: Windows](https://support.microsoft.com/windows): Official Windows support articles and troubleshooting resources.
- [Windows IT Pro Blog](https://techcommunity.microsoft.com/t5/windows-it-pro-blog/bg-p/Windows10Blog): Announcements and best practices for Windows servicing and management.
- [Microsoft Learn: Windows Deployment](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/deployment/): Documentation hub for Windows deployment, servicing, and update management.
- [Microsoft Learn Q&A: Windows](https://learn.microsoft.com/answers/tags/787/windows): Community questions and answers for Windows administration and troubleshooting.
